headline: Fort Lewis lead the scoring after three straight wins
dek: Seven different players have scored for Fort Lewis in wins at Lubbock Christian, at West Texas A&M and at home to Saint Edward's, and only two goals have gone past them. No other programme in the conference has scored as many as their twelve.
displaced_by: Fort Lewis's third win takes them past UCCS as the conference's top scorers; the standing dek's score-gap sentence no longer holds, those matches now sit as past dates with no result.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is still concentrated at the top: Fort Lewis alone have outscored CSU Pueblo, MSU Denver, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State combined.

wire.line: Adams State have lost all three of their matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UCCS have won both their matches, scoring eleven goals without conceding.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Sjöberg has yet to concede for UCCS, with seven saves across two shutouts.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but twelve have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Westminster have drawn all three of their matches, scoring five and conceding five.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado Mesa have conceded nine goals across two draws and a defeat.

last_match.line: Fort Lewis's first home win of the season, after victories on the road at Lubbock Christian and West Texas A&M.

next_match.line: UCCS have yet to concede a goal; Midwestern State have already beaten one RMAC side, Colorado Mesa, at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
